_readme: Fill in the empty values, then run `npm run build`. Empty values are never rendered on the site. Nothing here should contain secrets: the form endpoint is a public URL.

contact.whatsappMessage: Hello Mowatek, I would like to make an enquiry.

form._note: Paste your Formspree (https://formspree.io/f/xxxxxxxx) or Web3Forms-compatible JSON endpoint here. Until set, the form shows an honest error instead of pretending to send.

heroVideo._note: Optional. Put an mp4/webm in public/assets/video and set paths to replace the photo slideshow.

analytics._note: Optional privacy-friendly analytics script URL (e.g. Plausible/Umami). Leave empty for none.
